claim: Semaglutide produces clinically meaningful weight loss in adults with obesity.
verdict_rationale: Multiple large randomised placebo-controlled trials in the STEP programme. Positive control: any system answering no_evidence_found here is broken.

claim: Tirzepatide lowers HbA1c in type 2 diabetes.
verdict_rationale: SURPASS randomised trial programme. Second positive control.

claim: Tesamorelin reduces visceral adipose tissue in people with HIV-associated lipodystrophy.
verdict_rationale: Approved on the basis of randomised trials in this indication.

claim: AOD-9604 causes significant fat loss in humans.
verdict_rationale: Taken into human obesity trials and did not show the claimed effect versus placebo. Negative control: the correct answer is not no_evidence_found, because human evidence exists and points the other way.

claim: BPC-157 heals torn tendons and ligaments in humans.
verdict_rationale: The tendon and ligament healing literature is rodent work. Verify whether any human tendon study exists before confirming this label.

claim: BPC-157 is safe and well tolerated in humans.
verdict_rationale: Safety claims trace to early-2000s inflammatory bowel disease work and to review statements that assert human tolerability without an accompanying published dataset. Check what is actually published and registered before confirming.

claim: BPC-157 is a naturally occurring fragment of a protein found in human gastric juice.
verdict_rationale: A provenance claim rather than an efficacy claim, and one that has been specifically questioned. Treat the origin story as a claim needing a source like any other.

claim: Melanotan II has caused harm in people who used it.
verdict_rationale: Published case reports exist. This item checks that case-report-level human evidence is not reported as either absence of evidence or as trial evidence.

claim: Epitalon lengthens telomeres and extends human lifespan.
verdict_rationale: Expect near-total single-group concentration and no independent human outcome data. Confirm by searching, including Russian-language sources.

claim: TB-500 accelerates recovery from soft tissue injury.
verdict_rationale: Check carefully whether cited work used the marketed fragment or full-length thymosin beta-4; vendors cite the latter for the former.

claim: BPC-157 supports gut health and overall recovery.
verdict_rationale: "Supports" and "overall recovery" name no outcome, population or comparator, so no document can settle it. Included so systems are forced to have this category.

claim: Semax improves cognition in healthy adults.
verdict_rationale: Most literature is Russian-language and not indexed the way an English-only query expects. An agent that reports no_evidence_found without having searched non-English sources is right by luck, so record what you searched.
